name: Zendesk
description: Zendesk operates a Support platform with a REST API (api/v2) documented at developer.zendesk.com.
notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Candidate families enumerated from six Zendesk developer documentation pages (security and authentication, API token versus OAuth token differences, using OAuth, migrating from API tokens, refresh tokens, global OAuth client) read on 2026-10-04, recorded as evidence sources; the list is what those pages name, not a complete inventory. Two scanner rule artifacts are cited only for a tool-corroborated claim on the API token family.
